name: KA-SAT 2022 (Viasat) - SPARTA
description: KA-SAT / AcidRain attack of 24 Feb 2022 mapped to SPARTA v4.0.1. Score = attack phase (1-6). Most mappings are by analogy: the satellite was not touched; the targets were user terminals.

techniques.comment: Phase 1: Compromise Ground System: VPN misconfiguration -> trusted management segment.
Phase 2: Ground System Presence: attacker held a foothold in the management network (dwell time unknown).
Phase 2: Credentialed Traversal (by analogy): LM-0007 targets onboard/constellation traversal; credential use not confirmed by Viasat.
Phase 3: Malicious Commanding via Valid GS (by analogy): command origin appeared valid; misuse of legitimate command authority.
Phase 3: Native Functionality Abuse - vector: Disable (by analogy): legitimate management function used to run the wiper.
Phase 4: Trusted Relationship: User Segment (partial, reverse direction): provider management plane used against trusting terminals.
Phase 5: Software, Firmware, or Programmable Logic Manipulation - vector: Disable (by analogy): AcidRain wipes flash/storage.
Phase 5: Data Manipulation - vector: Disable (by analogy): file overwrite/delete step.
Phase 6: Resource Exhaustion or Contention - vector: Subvert (by analogy): modem DoS degraded network access for legitimate modems.

legendItems.label: By analogy (framework written for a different segment)
